params.caption: 🕹️ Twitch builds new ad tech for GTA 6 streams Twitch has created ad technology made for GTA 6 that lets brands keep their ads away from parts of the game they do not want to be linked with. The aim is to make advertisers more comfortable on GTA 6 streams, so streamers can earn more from them. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 20:12 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @Twitch · @RockstarGames 📺 React 👀 if you'll watch GTA 6 streams · 💬 Good move or too much? #GTA6 #Twitch #Streaming #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
